parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the cloud account.

parameters.name: CloudCode
parameters.description:
The code of the cloud service provider.

Valid values:

*   qcloud
*   hcloud
*   aliyun

parameters.name: DataSourceInstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the data source.

parameters.name: DataSourceInstanceParams
parameters.description: The parameters of the data source. Set this parameter to a JSON array.

parameters.name: DataSourceInstanceRemark
parameters.description: The remarks on the data source.

parameters.name: DataSourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

*   obs: Huawei Cloud Object Storage Service (OBS)
*   wafApi: download API of Tencent Cloud Web Application Firewall (WAF)
*   ckafka: Tencent Cloud Kafka (CKafka)

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the data management center of the threat analysis feature resides. Specify this parameter based on the regions in which your assets reside. Valid values:

*   cn-hangzhou: Your assets reside in regions in China.
*   ap-southeast-1: Your assets reside in regions outside China.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem add-data-source --account-id 123xxxxxxxx --data-source-type obs --data-source-instance-name XX-Beijing-Kafka --data-source-instance-remark XX_Cloud_Firewall_Shanghai_instance --data-source-instance-params paraCode_:_region_code_,_paraValue_:_ap-guangzhou --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloud-siem AddDataSource --region cn-hangzhou --CloudCode hcloud --AccountId 123xxxxxxxx --DataSourceInstanceParams 'paraCode_:_region_code_,_paraValue_:_ap-guangzhou' --DataSourceType obs --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DataSourceInstanceName 'XX-Beijing-Kafka' --DataSourceInstanceRemark XX_Cloud_Firewall_Shanghai_instance
